aperture.name: Pineal Aperture
aperture.role: observer-local selection aperture and comparison cut
aperture.boundary: not a third carrier and not a model of pineal physiology

source.role: declared model source address behind the aperture

grammar: Milky Way <-> Pineal Aperture <-> Andromeda; declared model source -> aperture -> typed residual -> return
controls: trace, residual, address and pause toggles
graph node, edge and trinity accounting
characteristic polynomial of the displayed adjacency graph

inside_frame_navigator.earth_sky_rule: Milky Way becomes the background field, Pineal Aperture becomes the observer window, and Andromeda is represented as a deep-sky object. Imported right ascension and declination are used when available; otherwise the view is labeled procedural.
inside_frame_navigator.solar_rule: The Sun is the heliocentric origin, planets form nested orbit traces, Earth carries a local Moon orbit, and the Oort Cloud is shown only as a schematic outer shell.
inside_frame_navigator.saturn_rule: Saturn is the planetocentric origin; its ring plane and seven named moon tracks form the local orientation grid, with Titan highlighted.
inside_frame_navigator.uranus_rule: Uranus is the planetocentric origin; the strongly tilted local axis, rings and five named moon tracks define the orientation grid.
inside_frame_navigator.loki_rule: Two Q3 sign-state layers of eight nodes are joined by eight green fourth-coordinate edges into the 16-node, 32-edge Q4 carrier. Iota marks the directed cut and Pearl marks the bounded aperture.
inside_frame_navigator.closure_transit_rule: A declared carrier passes through Transform/Trace, Query/Cut and Reconstruct/Return. HRT records the seam crossing; a declared comparator assigns exact return, tolerance closure, near-closure or visual closure only.

closure_modes.exact: d(M, M_hat) equals zero on the complete declared comparison domain
closure_modes.tolerance: zero is less than d(M, M_hat), which is less than or equal to declared epsilon
closure_modes.near: d(M, M_hat) exceeds declared epsilon and remains a typed residual trace
closure_modes.visual: contours align in the selected view but no mathematical closure authority is asserted

inside_frame_navigator.scale_boundary: Solar and planetary frames are schematic orientation views, not scale models, measured ephemerides or claims of simultaneous alignment.

figure_inspector.name: Trinity and Polynomial Inspector
figure_inspector.selection_rule: For every declared local figure target, select the nearest unused procedural carrier node.
figure_inspector.graph_rule: Connect selected nodes in the declared preset order. In two-carrier mode, add the aperture and a three-edge bridge between the first selected node of each carrier and the aperture.
figure_inspector.trinity_rule: Enumerate every three-vertex clique in the displayed adjacency graph.
figure_inspector.polynomial_rule: Compute the characteristic polynomial det(lambda I minus A) of the displayed undirected adjacency matrix A.

proxy_fields: spectral class O, B, A, F, G, K or M
normalized near, middle or far depth band
stellar_node_mapper.interaction: Click a visible stellar node to inspect its complete deterministic proxy record.
stellar_node_mapper.export: The selected stellar node and the active mapper mode and filter are included in the observer-state record.
stellar_node_mapper.catalog_ingest_boundary: Measured right ascension, declination, distance, photometry, uncertainty and source identifiers require a named external catalog and are not synthesized by this fixture.

star_map_importer.execution: local browser only; the selected file is not uploaded
accepted_coordinates: right ascension and declination in degrees
normalized x and y with optional z
star_map_importer.fallback_carrier: User may explicitly assign rows without a carrier column to Milky Way or Andromeda.
star_map_importer.projection: Coordinates are normalized separately inside each carrier. Raw source fields remain attached to the selected node record.
star_map_importer.validation: Instrument records and observer-state records are rejected. Missing or blank coordinates remain null and are never coerced to zero.
star_map_importer.template_boundary: Template rows are explicitly labeled demonstration data and are not catalog measurements.

interpretation: Two procedural carrier fields are observed through one adjustable aperture. The display makes selection, phase relation, support and residual observer-relative and exportable.
nonclaims: The artifact does not establish a physical coupling between the Milky Way and the Andromeda Galaxy.
Pineal Aperture is an expression-layer observer and aperture operator, not a biological measurement or pineal-gland model.
Visual synchrony, pulsing or overlap is not evidence of causal synchrony.
SOURCE_0 is a declared model address, not a claim about the origin of nature.
The procedural carrier fields are schematic and are not astronomical sky maps.
The Green Bridge and Loki view is a projected discrete sign-state fixture, not a physical four-dimensional object or substance ontology.
Visual closure is view-local and is not exact or tolerance closure without a declared comparator, domain, metric and threshold.
A generated figure is a declared nearest-node selection, not a discovered astronomical object or natural law.
Stellar proxy properties are deterministic test data and are not astronomical measurements or catalog entries.
Importing a file does not by itself authenticate its astronomical provenance or measurement quality.
